This period at a glance

Auto-generated from the data currently loaded and filtered above

Between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-19, the kitchens logged 210 complaints against 11,664 units sold — a blended rate of 1.80%. Product Quality was the leading complaint category (40% of tickets), most often flagged as "Smashed" (27 tickets). French Fries was the most persistent recurring issue, complained about on 8 of the 19 day(s) in this window. (87 tickets had no product named on them and are excluded from product-level figures.)
